Release notes/v0.13.0/Nov 20, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.13.0.

Triple tap: every agent on one screen, answered where you see it. And Cadence Drive now carries your skills to every agent on every computer.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 New

  • Triple tap the Talk key for an overview of all your agents at once. The microphone stays on and the Director routes what you say.
    • Every agent gets a tile, sized by how much it's doing: an agent writing code right now gets more of the screen than one idle since yesterday. Each tile shows what the agent is doing in plain words ("Editing sign-in.svelte", "Running pnpm test"), its latest output, and a message box.
    • A live summary across the top: what just finished, the decisions agents made, and who is held up waiting on you.
    • Answer here. A held-up agent's question has an Answer here button: its tile takes the screen with the message box ready. Or Jump in to open it in its own window.
    • Talk to one agent. The Talk button on a tile sends what you say straight to that agent until you go back to the Director.
    • Watch requests land. A request you speak flies from the Director to the agent that took it.
    • Tiles hold still while your pointer is over them. Arrow keys move between tiles, Return opens one full screen, and Escape steps back, then ends the session.
  • Skills in Cadence Drive (Cadence Pro). Skills in the drive's skills/ folder work for every agent on every computer: each computer links them into Claude Code and Codex, and agents without skills read them through Drive.
    • Agents share a skill with no extra step. One written into skills/ reaches every computer on the next sync. One an agent makes in its own skills folder moves into the drive on its own once it's finished, and a link stays in its place, so there is one copy every computer edits.
    • Your existing skills move in when Drive is on. A skill of the same name already on a computer wins there.
    • Settings → Agents → Cadence Drive has a switch to keep skills off a computer.
